problem: Duplicate native hotkey events could toggle recording off within 60 milliseconds.
Local Hina conversations could fail while capturing an external desktop selection.

behavior.tap: One press starts recording; a subsequent press stops recording. Native repeat events share the existing 600 ms repeat gate.
behavior.push: Physical key down starts assistant recording; physical release stops it.
behavior.localConversation: Commands go to the assistant panel without probing or editing an external selection. Explicit panel selections remain conversational context.

verification.limitation: A real spoken conversation after installation still needs user confirmation. Runtime route verification made no agent request.
